headline: Israeli bulldozers raze entire Jordan Valley community while residents vow to stay
label: NEWS
caption:
Palestinian families in the Jordan Valley refuse to leave despite losing everything. 🏠

According to Middle East Eye, Israeli forces demolished all structures in the West Bank community of Khirbet Samra on Sunday. Residents stated they received no prior notice and were given only ten minutes to retrieve their belongings before bulldozers destroyed homes, animal shelters, and water tanks.

Families are now living in tents provided by human rights organisations as winter approaches. Residents reported that the army even buried the debris to ensure nothing could be reused, leaving them sleeping in the open with their livestock.

The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs reported that approximately 6,800 Palestinians have been displaced since the beginning of 2023 due to settler attacks and land restrictions.

Will these families be able to rebuild their homes? 👇
